name: fixnear-functions
description: FixNear push notifications (Cloud Functions for Firebase, asia-southeast1).

scripts.test: npm run build && firebase --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-fixnear "node --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/test/*.test.js"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test lib/test/events.test.js lib/test/geo.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && firebase --config ../firebase.json emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-fixnear "node test/e2e-trigger.mjs"
